title: Rust: CCA TX and completion admission wiring
description:
Extend existing CCA and transmit calls in rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs and the Radio contract in rust/lichen-hal/src/lib.rs. Carry the admitted receiver channel/profile, preserve bounded contention, and recheck deadlines, complete fit, receiver commitments and legal/adaptive restrictions after awaits/backoff. Distinguish deferred, failed, emitted and completed events so cancellation or late completion cannot create unauthorized TX or erase airtime.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: CCA is already present; reuse b7z9.29 and current HAL mechanics rather than create a new retry framework. Consume rust.05/.06/.10/.11 policy and ledger decisions. Do not add dependencies on old roll-ups or admission-test consumers. Preserve current queue/back-pressure contracts, radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC/security and best-effort custody; leave audited OSCORE/EDHOC behavior untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Drive actual Stack send paths with deterministic HAL events and vectors.04/.06/.08. Assert no radio transmit after expiry, conflicting RX, consumed slack or exhausted budget; check correct physical channel/profile at CCA and TX. Cover clear/busy/error, cancellation, late completion and partial/uncertain emission accounting. CCA clear and TX completion are not delivery evidence and exhaustion does not choose SF12. Run focused std-enabled node/HAL tests, supported no_std checks, fmt and clippy.
